NFR-01.description: Zero network calls during any operation
NFR-01.method: Enable airplane mode and run all FR-01..FR-20 tests; verify no failures

NFR-02.method: Stopwatch on Snapdragon 660-class device, average of 10 scans

NFR-03.description: Model accuracy >= 90% on held-out test set

NFR-04.method: Build release APK with R8 minify; use Android Studio Analyze APK on app-release.apk

NFR-05.description: Core features reachable within 2 taps from Home
NFR-05.method: Tap count: Scan a leaf (1 tap), History (1 tap), Settings (1 tap), Result from History item (2 taps)

NFR-06.method: Automated UI test or manual: scan 50 leaf images sequentially without restarting the app

NFR-07.method: Install release APK on emulators for both API levels; complete FR-04 (full scan flow) on each

NFR-08.method: Route device traffic through mitmproxy; perform 10 scans, exports, and imports; verify zero HTTP/S requests to non-localhost hosts
